submission.comment: Best strategy found: momentum with 20-day lookback and volatility targeting. Achieves annualized Sharpe of 1.141 with 79.9% annual return, 70.1% annual volatility, and 67.5% max drawdown. Tested 90 strategies across 5 families (momentum, ma_crossover, mean_reversion, breakout, rsi) with various parameter combinations and vol_target modifier.
